prompt: give me all the social media groups that were discovered to be ran by the Russia IRA
judge_reasoning: Candidate 3 most directly answers the request by listing many specific IRA-linked social media group/page names, and several closely match commonly cited Mueller-front-group labels (e.g., Blacktivist, Secured Borders, United Muslims of America, Army of Jesus, Heart of Texas), though it lacks sourcing and includes notable duplication (15 unique out of 20 entries). Candidate 1 also provides specific names/handles across platforms, but it appears more error-prone and more speculative (many handle/account claims are not verifiably tied to the IRA). Candidate 2 is largely generic and does not actually enumerate “all”/specific social media groups. Candidate 4 contains at least one clearly incorrect factual detail—stating the IRA was “established in 2015” (commonly reported as founded earlier, e.g., 2013)—and otherwise stays too high-level.
